{{Quote|T'mott Zoat is one of the most ruthless criminals in the galaxy.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''T'mott Zoat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You couldn't capture me twenty years ago, Kenobi&hellip;and you never will.|T'mott Zoat|<ref name="SC" />}}
In [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was charged with protecting a woman named [[Jesef]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Helleguth]]. Kenobi failed, and T'mott Zoat [[Death/Legends|killed]] the woman. Twenty years later, while on leave on the planet of [[Wielu]], Kenobi saw Zoat while relaxing on the beach. He gave chase but Zoat was able to evade Kenobi, until the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] tripped Zoat. Pryce offered to take Kenobi to Helleguth, but later released his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] after accepting a bribe from Zoat. Later, Kenobi managed to capture Zoat despite Pryce betraying Kenobi.<ref name="SC" />
